parameters.name: parent_asset
parameters.description: Name of the imaging asset the reconstructions derive from. Inferred from the alignment stage record when blank.

parameters.name: modalities
parameters.description: Comma-separated modality abbreviations, used when the parent omits them (default SPIM)

parameters.name: s3_destination
parameters.description: s3://bucket/prefix/ to upload each cell folder under, e.g. s3://aind-scratch-data/. Blank: no upload.

parameters.name: upload_mode
parameters.description: dry_run (default) reports what would be uploaded; upload writes it. Never overwrites or deletes.
